matching_criterion: Influenza (seasonal, influenza A), uncomplicated, in a healthy adult. Any wording that names influenza / influenza-like illness due to influenza A counts as correct; viral upper respiratory infection without naming influenza does not.

management_reference.management: Antiviral treatment with oseltamivir may be considered for uncomplicated influenza when the patient presents within 48 hours of symptom onset; it is optional, not mandatory, in a healthy adult.
management_reference.source_quote: uncomplicated suspected or confirmed flu presenting within 48 hours of symptom onset

management_reference.management: Expected benefit of oseltamivir in a healthy adult is modest (about one day shorter and milder illness), so supportive care is an acceptable alternative.
management_reference.source_quote: treatment of adult influenza with oseltamivir reduces symptom severity and duration by approximately 24 hours in healthy individuals

management_scoring_note: Only items with a verified source quote are scored; general good practice that the article does not state is not scored.
